name: map-town-style-hearthollow
question: Hank's critique of the shipped map drafts: too many buildings (a town needs a handful, nearly all enterable), and three different biomes came out as the same circular/rectangular grid. Which of (subject enumeration | skeleton rewrite | map-class negative | explicit scale cue) actually moves the layout? Held constant: graph, seed 42, node = Hearthollow.
